notes.title: Adorable Crush - a new Hentai Crush sequel!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
We are happy to introduce you our main upcoming project [b]Adorable Crush[/b].
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266800
This is a new sequel of Hentai Crush series put you into a new world called VRMMO Simulation game "Another Life". Here you will have chance to connect and seduce many girl and get them to the bed.
This game will be more about the interaction with the characters, and also includes a similar mini game with HuniePop, promising many interesting experiences.

It will be release in this October, now you can follow our progress or ask us anything you interested here:
*Steam community: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1266800/discussions/0/2796124750782967870/
*Twitter: https://twitter.com/GamesMature
